description: Pinned picorv32_axi full physical top profile for a planned RV32I local environment. Source/profile facts only; generated harness and program execution are unassessed.

resets.release: picorv32.v samples resetn in posedge clk sequential blocks; assert and release resetn synchronously to clk.

capabilities.evidence: picorv32.v top declarations have 32-bit address/data and four byte lanes. max_outstanding=1 is the planned environment limit. No physical error response exists. The physical AXI top has no bresp or rresp. The plugin marks both runtime_required, so a later local transactor needs an explicit no-error variant; these profiles do not establish plugin runtime compatibility.

semantics: The physical AXI top has no bresp or rresp. The plugin marks both runtime_required, so a later local transactor needs an explicit no-error variant; these profiles do not establish plugin runtime compatibility.

All three top parameter declarations default ENABLE_PCPI=0, ENABLE_IRQ=0, COMPRESSED_ISA=0, ENABLE_MUL=0, ENABLE_FAST_MUL=0, ENABLE_DIV=0, PROGADDR_RESET=0. Explicit PCPI/IRQ overrides retain those disabled values.
The 50 MHz clock frequency is a planned environment setting, not a source-derived timing guarantee.
verified: The focused acceptance test elaborates all top ports using Verilator JSON, binds every declared protocol field direction/width, and classifies every physical bit.
unknown: No generated harness, real scenario runtime or real program execution is established.
Pico custom IRQ instructions do not establish standard machine-external interrupt delivery; ENABLE_IRQ=0 disables this mechanism.
